messages:
Zoe (CS): Heads-up: PineHarbor onboarding team reported morning P95 spikes and rising token spend on their invoice chat flow. renewal in ~58 days. Asking for low-risk recommendations we can pitch.
Ethan (Solutions): saw the graph. which model and region? any request-size distribution?
Zoe (CS): hosted redwood/gpt-large currently FP16, region: eu-north. 80% of requests are short (20-200 tokens) for PO extraction + 20% longer summaries. P95 baseline ~1.0s, spikes to ~3.5s during batch imports.
HealthBot: automated correlator: spikes align with ETL ingestion windows. Suggest: enable prefix KV caching for repetitive invoice templates; run a mixed-precision pilot (int8 for generator, int4 for ultra-short Summaries) with careful QA. Estimated token-cost -26%, P95 improvement ~30% on sampled traces.
Maya (SE): mixed-precision is higher risk but could be high reward. propose conservative plan: 1) int8 for generation tasks (default 10% traffic), 2) int4 only for summaries <80 tokens at 5% traffic (A/B), 3) keep extractor endpoints pinned to FP16, 4) prefix KV caching for invoice templates, 5) regional fallback to us-east for eu-north bursts.
Ethan (Solutions): interesting — int4 for summaries is novel. need to make rollback and guardrails explicit. PineHarbor cares a lot about extraction accuracy.
Zoe (CS): important: they must see zero regression on PO extraction. if extractor accuracy drops >0.5% we roll back immediately. also want a short customer micro-survey after 48h.
Rex (Eng): implementation checklist draft:
```
- create variants: redwood/gpt-large:int8-gen, redwood/gpt-large:int4-summ
- routing rules:
  * if tokens < 80 AND endpoint == summarizer -> route to int4-summ (5% traffic)
  * else if endpoint == generator AND tokens < 1500 -> int8-gen (10% traffic)
  * extractor endpoints: force model=redwood/gpt-large:fp16
- fallback policy: if region==eu-north AND p99_latency>2.5s -> route to us-east via policy pine-fallback
- caching: enable KV prefix cache for invoice_text and header templates
- tracing: tag traces `pineharbor-canary-8160001111`
- logging: extraction_accuracy, token-diff, and hallucination-check flags
```
Maya (SE): QA plan: 300-sample golden set for extraction, 150 for summaries. run automated diff + manual review of edge cases. auto-rollback rules: extractor accuracy drop >0.5% OR summary BLEU proxy delta >1.5% OR error increase >8% in 12h.
HealthBot: preflight eval on 180 samples: int8-gen accuracy drop 0.2% (within tolerance), int4-summ quality proxy delta 1.1% on short summaries; flagged 6 summary edge cases (tables & line-breaks). Recommend manual review of those 6 before turning on int4 to users.
Ethan (Solutions): will draft customer-facing pilot note w/ clear metrics: expected cost -25%, P95 -30%, 48h QA checkpoint, and 12h rollback window for severe regressions. Zoe, want a concise slide and the micro-survey?
Zoe (CS): yes please. include the micro-survey question set: 1) Did summary match expected fields? 2) Any missed PO numbers? 3) Was latency noticeably improved? (Likert).
Rex (Eng): streaming contract note: ensure client-side reconnect behavior is documented for fallback; no chunking changes. Also ensure SDK example shows per-route override.
Maya (SE): example SDK snippet for canary:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-large:int8-gen","route":"pine-fallback","metadata":{"tag":"pine-canary-8160001111"}}'
```
Ethan (Solutions): add a small user-visible ribbon for canary users: "You may be part of a performance pilot" so support can triage feedback fast. PineHarbor prefers transparency.
Zoe (CS): schedule 30m kickoff with PineHarbor CSM + infra + Solutions tomorrow. I'll own the feedback capture and 50 random prompt snapshots after 48h.
HealthBot: reminder scheduled: run auto-eval at 48h and post results to thread. Link to preflight: https://internal.redwood/evals/8160001111
Maya (SE): one more guard: if any extractor regression shows up, immediately pin extractor to fp16 and continue other pilots.
Rex (Eng): agreed. we'll emit an automatic rollback event and notify this thread.
Zoe (CS): thanks everyone. Ethan, can you have the pilot draft and slide by EOD? I'll send the kickoff invite once it's ready. :white_check_mark:
Ethan (Solutions): on it.
